08-1.title: Prompt injection defenses
08-1.tldr: Untrusted input can hijack the model (direct user input, or indirect via retrieved/tool content). Treat content as data, delimit/label it, never let it trigger privileged actions unchecked, and enforce with a permission layer.
points: Treat content as data, not instructions.

08-2.title: Untrusted tool output and documents
08-2.tldr: Treat tool output and retrieved docs as untrusted data: delimit and label them, strip control/escape sequences, and never let them trigger privileged actions without re-checking permissions.

08-3.title: Handling jailbreak attempts
08-3.tldr: Assume the model can be talked around, so enforce outside it: detect and block known patterns, keep privileged actions behind a permission check the model can't bypass, sandbox tools, and log/rate-limit attempts.
points: Assume the model can be manipulated.

08-4.title: Per-user document authorization
08-4.tldr: Enforce authorization inside retrieval: every chunk carries ACL metadata, and the query includes a mandatory filter derived from the caller's identity, applied by the vector store (pre-filter), not post-hoc.
points: Pre-filter in the store, not post-hoc.

08-5.title: Preventing destructive actions
08-5.tldr: Layer defenses: classify actions by risk, deny known-dangerous patterns, require approval for the ambiguous middle, and prefer reversible operations over hard blocks. Fail closed — unknown should ask.

08-6.title: Preventing harmful or biased output
08-6.tldr: Layer defenses: a system-prompt safety instruction, input/output classifiers/moderation, policy filters on generated output, and refusal behavior validated by red-teaming. A prompt is advice, not a control.
points: Safety instruction in the system prompt.

08-7.title: Preventing sensitive data leakage
08-7.tldr: Detect and redact secrets before they reach the model or logs: scrub known patterns (keys, tokens, PII) from tool results and prompts, redact log fields, gate secret-like egress, and rely on provider zero-retention.
points: Redact log fields (not drop whole events).

08-8.title: Multi-tenant RAG isolation
08-8.tldr: Isolation choices, strongest first: a separate index/collection per tenant; a tenant partition key with mandatory pre-filtering; or row-level security. The tenant filter must be applied inside the store.
